rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the seal
technical term for a ritual gesture or seal

items.question: What supreme power of attraction does this seal possess over the three worlds?
premises: This seal is attracting in nature.
This seal attracts the three worlds.
This seal is characterized as supreme.
items.inference: Therefore this seal is the supreme attracting seal whose power extends over the three worlds.
items.plain_english: This is the attracting seal, the supreme one that draws in the three worlds.
